title: Short-Sale Daily Accrual — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction
content:
Short-sale daily accrual — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the per diem recorded is the short-sale daily accrual: the amount by which the payoff grows for each day.

**Scope.** For an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, and only for such a payoff, the per diem is the short-sale daily accrual; every payoff case other than such a short-sale payoff and a retention payoff keeps its per diem as the loan balance on the statement date times the loan's note rate plus, for a HECM, the annual MIP rate, divided by the plan's per diem day count, rounded half up to the cent.

The per diem is recorded when payoff terms are asked for on such a case.

## Recording the short-sale daily accrual

**Capability.** The tool records the daily accrual (per diem) on a borrower's short-sale payoff case. The case's daily accrual is replaced by the amount passed in; its status and every other figure on the case stay as they are, and the statement request and maturity case named are quoted back in the receipt. On success the case shows the new daily accrual, which can be quoted to the borrower.

**How it is invoked.** `record_sale_daily_accrual_1c6aaad4` is an agent-side tool; the agent unlocks it, then calls it.

**Parameters.**
- `payoff_case_id`: the reference number of the payoff case, as returned by the payoff case lookup.
- `payoff_request_id`: the reference number of the payoff statement request on file that this write answers, as returned by the payoff submission lookup.
- `maturity_case_id`: the reference number of the loan's maturity case, as returned by the maturity case lookup.
- `per_diem_amount`: the daily accrual to record, in USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent.

**Return.** A confirmation naming the payoff case, statement request and maturity case reference numbers and the daily accrual now recorded (USD, 2 decimal places); the words "daily accrual recorded" show the write completed. No other return or error is defined for this tool.
